title: Owner of Coimbatore pet boarding facility booked after Indie dog dies under care due to alleged negligence
firstParagraph: The police have registered a case against the owner of a pet boarding centre at Saravanampatty in Coimbatore after an Indie dog lodged at the facility for care died of alleged negligence earlier this month.
lastParagraph: Revathi Thangavel, owner of Cuddle Club House – Cage Free Dog Boarding and Grooming, was booked for offence under Section 11 (treating animals cruelly) of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, based on a complaint lodged by Adarsh Chandrasekaran, a resident of Fathima Nagar at Saravanampatty.
